correctness.rationale: Girard signed spherical-angle formula proves exact eight-area identities and the range identity. Conditioning on two normal dot products derives the correct Gram arcsine density. Its sign-symmetrized Taylor expansion has constant and quartic terms; the first nonzero odd-sign-invariant remainder is degree six. Symbolic triple integration gives volume 2 and quartic moment 7/120. Integration over the rescaled polytope gives precisely epsilon^3/(16pi)+7epsilon^7/(122880pi)+O(epsilon^9); L1 convergence of rescaled conditional densities yields the marked total-variation and Beta(3,1) conclusions. Independent geometric and numerical checks match these steps.

value.rationale: The spread between largest and smallest areas is a natural measure of uniformity for the eight antipodal cells of three randomly oriented great circles. The sharp cubic rarity near the regular spherical octant configuration, the exceptional absence of intermediate asymptotic orders and the explicit seventh-order coefficient reveal geometric near-isotropy beyond existing marginal laws. The marked polytope-uniform limit provides a structural model of the rare perturbations. This result is not an arbitrary one-off number.
